Cloudflare Universal SSL (only used when proxied).

settings.$comment: Applied in this order. ssl_automatic_mode=custom stops Automatic SSL/TLS from overriding ssl. always_use_https stays off: Vercel already redirects to HTTPS, and a Cloudflare redirect on port 80 can break Let's Encrypt HTTP-01 renewals when proxied.

botManagement.$comment: Keeps AI search, answer, and training crawlers allowed (GEO/AEO) and stops Cloudflare from prepending its own robots.txt. Only these fields are sent; anything else tuned in the dashboard is left alone.

redirect.$comment: Only takes effect when www is proxied. In DNS-only mode set the www redirect to 308 in Vercel instead (see README).
